# Impact model (generated by src/impact.py from config/impact.yaml)

For 1000 people living alone with telecare, monitored for one year. Every parameter is sourced or marked as a hypothesis in `config/impact.yaml`.

## When does it pay off?

The decisive unknown is the **real-life false-alert rate**, which public videos cannot measure. With the central values, the system pays off if false alerts stay below **0.021 per person per day (one every 47 days)**.

| Scenario | False alerts per person | Avoidable share of a hospitalized fall's cost | Detection rate | Long lies avoided | Net value per person per year |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| optimistic | one every 100 days | 40% | 90% | 78 | **+291 EUR** |
| central | one every 20 days | 20% | 68% | 58 | **-107 EUR** |
| pessimistic | one every 5 days | 5% | 59% | 51 | **-1,802 EUR** |

## Health benefits not counted in euros

- About **58 long lies (≥ 1 h on the floor) avoided per year** (central; 51 to 78 across scenarios), out of 180.
- Long lies (>= 1 h on the floor) are strongly associated with serious injury, hospital admission and moves into long-term care (Fleming & Brayne, BMJ 2008, https://doi.org/10.1136/bmj.a2227).
- After a hospitalized fall, the adjusted risk of death over 2 years is 2.14 times higher than for matched non-fallers (Mounié et al., JAMDA 2023, Santé publique France).
- France, people 65+, 2024: 174,824 hospitalizations and 20,148 deaths related to a fall (Santé publique France, national bulletin of 12 March 2026).
- The euros above only count part of the hospital cost; deaths, moves into care homes and quality of life are not monetized, so the value is a lower bound.

## Central scenario in detail

| Quantity | Value |
|---|---|
| Long lies (≥ 1 h on the floor) | 180 |
| Long lies avoided by the camera | 58 |
| Value of avoided long lies | 137,589 EUR |
| False alerts | 18,250 (cost 10.09 EUR each) |
| Cost of false alerts | 184,142 EUR |
| System cost | 60,000 EUR |
| **Net value** | **-106,554 EUR (-107 EUR / person / year)** |
| Break-even false-alert rate | 0.021 per person per day (one every 47 days) |
| R = cost of a missed fall / cost of a false alert | 70 |
